abstracts.abstract: A CONCURRENT RESOLUTION TO REQUEST THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION NAME THE INTERSECTION OF UNITED STATES HIGHWAY 321 AND SOUTH CAROLINA HIGHWAY 322 IN THE CITY OF MCCONNELLS IN YORK COUNTY "SHERIFF JOE MITCHELL INTERSECTION" AND ERECT APPROPRIATE SIGNS OR MARKERS AT THIS LOCATION CONTAINING THESE WORDS.

posted_text:
🛣️ SC H 5410 — Intersection in Rock Hill to Honor Former Sheriff

The South Carolina Department of Transportation will name the intersection of US Highway 321 and SC Highway 322 in Rock Hill as the "Sheriff Joe Mitchell Intersection," recognizing the service of former York County Sheriff Joe Mitchell…

June 25, 2026: Recalled from Committee on Transportation.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess126_2025-2026/bills/5410.htm
